I have found this veterinary clinic to be unethical and and trustworthy. There is many good reviews so why I went to this place after recommended by an Expat group. The veterinary clinic was advertising for a €55 teeth cleaning. We called to confirm this and scheduled an appointment. Upon arrival at my appointment. Which I was exactly on time I was led to a room where I waited 30 minutes. The veterinary technician came in and explained they were very busy, which is understandable, the technician and the veterinarian cleaned my dogs teeth. At the time I believed the price was what they had told me €55 and believed it to be a quality procedure for the price I was told. It took about 40 minutes approximately after the procedure they explained that I would need to return in a month where they would touch up any leftover issues left on the teeth and it would be in an additional €55. I told them that I would return. Upon paying my fee was €150. They charge me for a consultation, the teeth cleaning and for toothpaste. The consultation fee was €73 and not explained to prior to the appointment. When I questioned the consultation fee, they explained it was necessary for the health of the dog. The only consultation done on my dog was literally too points one asking me the weight and the veterinarian spending approximately 10 to 20 second petting and touching my dogs Abdomen prior to the cleaning. Nothing else. Certainly not an exam. No instruments or temperature was used. Literally nothing else happened. I do believe that like many expats I was completely overcharged here and taken advantage of. Truly a shame. But I guarantee no other expats will not hear of what happened here or already have.
With all honesty if I were to pay the €200 plus for a teeth cleaning, I would’ve went to my vet where the dog would have been put to sleep so but not be in any discomfort and the job would have been much more thorough.
Excellent professionals, I highly recommend them. My dogs love being there, great service, my dogs are happy.

Dras. Sara and Catarina are amazing! My two dogs are older and were struggling to walk. Within weeks they are eating better, pain free and love going in for their acupuncture. It has taken some effort to adjust their diets, but they are both healthier than in a long time and I am looking forward to enjoying them for many years. The whole team is helpful and kind and it is obvious they not only know what they are doing, but they love it!!

The staff, the knowledge of the doctors, and the expertise and kindness with how they treat animals combines to make this, the best veterinary service we have ever had. Our dog moved here from the United States in September and was basically suffering from chronic pain in her spine and legs and her quality of life had greatly diminished. We just assumed because she was 12 that was the best that it could be but since being here and getting treatment at InVet with Dr. Sarah, she is comfortable happy and doing better than she has in a long time the Acupuncture, the diet and the herbs that she’s on have changed everything . Dr. Sarah and her staff treat the whole animal and have given Lucy a wonderful senior quality of life. I highly highly recommend InVet.!
Amazing team 💞 …

My experience at In Vet was extremely disappointing. I have a dog with allergy problems for several years and, after many unsuccessful attempts with traditional medicine, I decided to try alternative medicine with Dr. Sara. Right from the first consultation, we were recommended several changes: food, shampoo, and supplements... and we started monthly rectal ozone therapy sessions, which were supposed to bring improvements.
For months we followed all the instructions we could, spending time and money, but my dog ​​continued to have allergic reactions. When she had a more serious reaction, it was necessary to resort to antibiotics, which also did not work. Only in a later consultation with another doctor was we finally informed that alternative medicine "doesn't always work." Something that should have been said right at the beginning.
To make matters worse, the last time we were at the clinic was in July, and to this day we have never received a single contact to find out how my dog ​​was doing. Zero follow-up, zero interest.
I felt a total lack of transparency, empathy, and professionalism. It seemed clear that the focus was solely on continuing to sell treatments, without any real concern for the animal's well-being. I do not recommend this clinic.

I recommend InVet to everyone looking to provide their pets with a holistic approach and access to differentiated healthcare.
My 15-year-old cat has been followed by a "conventional" veterinarian for several years and has always received excellent treatment. However, when a specific health situation arose, I decided to try new approaches so that my kitten could benefit from more complete and complementary care to what he was already receiving.
When I sought out InVet for this purpose, Dr. Sara explained everything that the approach they follow could do for Kiko, and the results were impressive. He recovered and went from a debilitated geriatric cat to a geriatric cat full of energy and with a good quality of life. We continue with regular follow-up to maintain the results achieved.
Thank you for everything, for all the care.

The reception our dog received from the staff was top-notch.
Dr. Sara provided 5-star service.

My French bulldog was suffering from terrible back pain. I had already consulted several veterinarians, and he was heavily medicated, but there were no signs of improvement. Seeing him suffer was breaking my heart 💔 I confess that when I heard about acupuncture, I also had many doubts... does it really work? Would it help? I decided to try it, on the advice of a close friend. And the truth is that the result exceeded all my expectations. Right after the session, he left super relaxed, slept a deep and peaceful sleep 💤… and when he woke up, he seemed like a different dog: cheerful, full of energy, playful, wanting to move from one side to the other.
It was simply fantastic!
So, if anyone has doubts like I did, my advice is: try it. It can make all the difference. 🐾❤️

A huge thank you to the entire @invet.pt team for everything you've done for Rocky 🩵🐶🐾

It was with you that he found the right support for his joint rehabilitation, starting with his front paw, affected by osteoarthritis, and more recently with the recovery of his operated paw.

And it's with you that he continues to live a quality life today, even with osteoarthritis (never losing the sparkle in his eyes that characterizes him so much, nor the rebellious spirit that insists on doing his usual crazy things, completely oblivious to the effects of age) 😅

Acupuncture has been a precious ally, and your professionalism, experience, and care make all the difference in Rockyteen's quality of life.

Thank you so much ❤️

Highly recommended
Excellent care, divine salvation! Excellent professionals! I recommend them 1000% 👏🏻 Congratulations on all the dedication and merit! …
Wonderful team ✨🫶🏼 Always so kind to Pipoca, and she's grateful for the cookies 🤪 …

I met Dr. Sara 6 years ago when she came to my house to do acupuncture on my Akita Shuma.
I continue to go to Invet regularly and have advised other people to take their animals there as an alternative or last resort for their animals' illnesses, as is the case with a friend's dog for whom traditional veterinary medicine no longer had an answer for the two tumors, mouth and head. At the moment, she is undergoing integrative medicine treatments with positive results in controlling the disease.
All the staff at the clinic are professional, very dedicated and caring.

Invet Veterinary Clinic has a comprehensive and very careful approach to animal health. All the professionals – Dr. Sara, Dr. Catarina, Dr. Inês, Emília, Raquel, and Ana – are extremely competent, caring, and patient with both the animals they care for and their owners. For me, it's a relief to know I can count on this wonderful team, and my dog ​​always leaves in good spirits, even when she has to undergo difficult treatments. Her time is respected, and she is always very well cared for! Thank you!

A team that has the professionalism, knowledge, and heart to treat animals and their owners.
Fantastic, I recommend them wholeheartedly, and we don't know how we lived without them anymore.
Special kisses from Aipim!!!! And also Soya, the kittens Chia and Capitu also say hi because they are cats, not out of lack of gratitude. And my gratitude to you is immeasurable. Thank you so much for accompanying us on this journey.
I highly recommend it! Pleasant environment and Dr. Sara helps with everything possible.
Great people, our dog always comes out happy and pain-free! very effective treatments. our dog actually loves coming here!

Me and my girl had the luck of meeting Dr. Sara Pinto Cardoso four years ago and Invet had been crucial in allowing Anti to live her best life in her golden years! I cannot thank Invet enough!

Dr. Beatriz is always very attentive and concerned about what's best for my little Oscar. What initially attracted me to choosing the Invet clinic to care for my Oscar was the fact that they are proponents of more natural treatments such as homeopathy, acupuncture, among others, which are less aggressive to the body.
They never stop using allopathic treatments if necessary and in more serious cases.
One medicine complements the other.
Thank you to the whole team.
